scope: Native Apple Motion anatomical-right leg-root canary: provisional upper-leg pivot, fixed body-space source-derived root-cover construction, neutral restoration, corrected five-angle sweep, and separate +15 degree overtravel diagnostic.

root_cover.intended_z_order: above rotating anatomical-right leg chain and below shorts/body
root_cover.failure_observation: The corrected v2 sweep shows the masked duplicate as a rounded opaque peach-colour lobe around the lower upper-leg or knee seam instead of a hidden root socket. Positive angles also open a sharp triangular dark or transparent wedge below the shorts, and every nonzero angle shows a hard upper-leg to lower-leg discontinuity.

neutral_parity.comparison_decode: Pillow RGBA 8-bit normalized decode of the two supported 16-bit PNG exports

overtravel_diagnostic.observation: The root wedge and displaced opaque cover lobe are more pronounced at +15 degrees. This overtravel angle is diagnostic only and is not a published control range.

attempt_history.observation: Motion displayed the requested angle values but the numeric field was not committed before Share. All labelled exports were byte-identical to neutral and were excluded from the final review sheets.
Committed -12, -6, +6, +12, and +15 degree captures produced distinct files and exposed the displaced cover lobe, root wedge, and leg-segment discontinuity.
Covered and no-cover exports are byte-identical, proving that this cover state contributed no rendered pixels to the exposed root gap.
This later neutral export is byte-identical to the approved Motion reference, but no complete accepted rotated sweep was produced from it.
The complement preserved alpha support topology but still changed neutral edge and texture pixels, so it did not satisfy exact neutral restoration.

checks.observation: The v4 supported neutral export has zero changed decoded RGBA pixels against the approved v11 Motion reference under the recorded normalized decode.
The anatomical-right upper-leg pivot remains at source coordinate (582, 680), stored as Motion anchor and matching position compensation (-45, -53). This does not approve the pivot.
The corrected -12, -6, 0, +6, +12, and separate +15 degree files have distinct hashes where movement is expected. The earlier uncommitted capture set was excluded.
The static source-derived cover is visibly displaced from the leg root and forms a rounded opaque lobe near the lower upper-leg seam. It does not prevent a positive-angle root wedge.
The same construction defects remain visible on checkerboard, light neutral, and dark plum backgrounds.

The corrected v2 sweep rotates only the upper-leg segment and exposes a hard discontinuity against the unlinked lower leg. A later linked-chain diagnostic moved the lower leg and shoe but did not produce an accepted covered sweep.
The +15 degree diagnostic amplifies the same defects and is not an approved control limit.
This failed canary is not eligible for human rig approval or promotion.

passed_scope: Provisional pivot placement and exact neutral restoration evidence only.
failed_scope: Fixed body-space anatomical-right root-cover stress performance and complete leg-chain continuity across the requested rotation range.
next_safe_action: Retain this run as failed evidence. Build a complete anatomical-right leg and shoe chain, then create a source-derived root socket whose covered export differs from the uncovered export only inside the exposed root gap, remains fully hidden at neutral, and passes a fresh -12, -6, 0, +6, +12 sweep before any rig promotion.
approval_scope_warning: This report does not approve the provisional pivot, root-cover mask, leg chain, rig, motions, expressions, templates, exports as reusable assets, deployment, or external handoff. No human approval is claimed.
